slides.title: The problem
slides.body: Before joining a cohort, it helps to know the workload, prerequisites, project expectations, and how to get unstuck.

slides.title: Control 1
slides.body: You should be comfortable with basic programming, Git, GitHub, and the command line.

slides.title: Control 2
slides.body: You do not need a GPU or previous AI tools experience.

slides.title: Control 3
slides.body: The course focuses on planning, coding, review, testing, agents, security, DevOps, and a final project.
